# Homeworks Property Improvements

> Specialist sash window restoration, joinery and period property care across Leicestershire, UK. Established 2005. Free, no-obligation estimates and no call-out fees.

- Website: https://homeworksleicester.co.uk/
- Phone: 07919 376335 (+44 7919 376335)
- Email: info@homeworksleicester.co.uk
- Area served: the whole of Leicestershire, including Leicester and Loughborough

## Sash windows (core specialism)

Restoring and upgrading existing sash windows is a cost-effective alternative to buying new windows. Services: window inspections, freeing up of sash windows, re-cording and re-balancing, draught proofing, box sash and casement repairs, repainting, re-glazing, window furniture and locks.

Rotten timber is repaired with the RepairCare DryFlex system, as specified by English Heritage and the National Trust for period timber repairs: strip back and stabilise, splice and bond new timber with a flexible resin, insert splices, make new end boxes where needed, then plane and paint like wood.

## Other services

General repairs, fireplace restoration, painting and decorating, flooring, re-glazing and draught excluding, tiling, joinery, and an hourly or daily handyman service. No job is too small.

## Recent projects

- Grade II listed former Rectory: Georgian sash windows and joinery restored, sill replacement, internal pocket shutters refurbished.
- Georgian sash window restoration: windows repaired, repainted, re-corded and fitted with draught exclusion; badly damaged windows repaired in the workshop.
- Victorian bay window restoration: 1900s bay-fronted terrace; box sash windows restored with the RepairCare DryFlex system.
